name: webforge-offline-ui
title: WebForge offline UI and networking-entry consolidation
description: Audit and hide every network-reaching entry in the WebForge product (git remote, login, cloud terminal, cloud projects, HTTP tool, external proxy) via qfli_studio_core offlineOnly/isOffline, keep loopback local web preview, unify the home UI/tools surface while keeping exactly five PageView pages, and fix narrow-screen / large-text layout with tests.
creator: lichengyu
notes: Five-page product tools integration and offline entry gating verified in 82 product tests, 116 shared regressions and Android five-page visual review. Markup oracle passes 200/200; full frozen content 301/301 with 1820 assertions. Shared fixes remain separately committed in core.
